## Context / Problem
The parent-first cascade is implemented twice: `src/rebar/_commands/claim.py:200-237` (hardcodes the `open` parent via `_resolve_open_parent`) and `src/rebar/_commands/transition.py:421-493` (`_cascade_parent_first`, driven by the `_CASCADING_EDGES` table at `transition.py:414`). The table was added after bug `cranial-sulfur-peafowl` and extended again for `paragonite-fruited-minnow` — both were "an edge the cascade did not know about" — and the claim copy still cannot express any edge but `open→in_progress`. The ghost/init preconditions at `transition.py:308-323` and `claim.py:156-169` are byte-identical. Open task `convenient-unrational-songbird` covers the table's one-status-per-edge shape and open bug `despotic-prime-reindeer` covers inbound reconcile bypassing the cascade; this story is the single implementation both of those then build on.

## Approach
Add `src/rebar/_commands/lifecycle_cascade.py` with `cascade_parent_first(ticket_id, edge, op, tracker, *, seen, **op_kwargs)` holding the one `_CASCADING_EDGES` table, the TOCTOU re-check, and the error rewrap preserving `ConcurrencyMismatch`; `claim_compute` passes `op=claim_compute` (assignee passthrough kept, `--review` deliberately not propagated per `claim.py:178-183`), `transition_compute` passes itself. Fold the ghost/init triple into `_seam.require_live_ticket`. Guard: `_CASCADING_EDGES` is defined once (AST check, no marker needed).


## Guard construction
Follow the guard-test construction rule in the parent epic `airborne-wellloved-kingfisher`: owner module exempt, match the constituent conjunction or AST shape named in Approach (or the definition count where no distinctive atom exists), `# <construct>-ok: <reason>` escape marker, and behaviour pinned only by the named existing tests.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_commands/lifecycle_cascade.py` (new), `src/rebar/_commands/claim.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/transition.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/_seam.py`, `tests/unit/commands/test_lifecycle_cascade.py` (new).

## Testing
Happy path: claiming a child of an open parent claims the parent first on both surfaces. Edge: a parent already taken by another session raises `ConcurrencyMismatch` with the same exit code as today. Pinning: `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_claim_transition_parent_cascade.py` and the cascade tests from `cranial-sulfur-peafowl`/`paragonite-fruited-minnow` pass unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `grep -rn "_CASCADING_EDGES\s*=" src/rebar` returns one definition; checked by the grep and the guard test.
- [ ] Every edge in the table is exercised by the same test for both `claim` and `transition`; checked by a parametrised test over the table.
- [ ] Pinning suites pass unchanged; checked by `pytest`.
